# Placeholder named species: plain blocks and bars, test inputs only, not game art. Read after quadruped.txt, whose
# colours, iris ramps and radial and flora fallbacks it uses; it does not parse alone.
# Four species at the medium tier, each on its own scaffold <family>/<key>/medium, every part of kind <key> at v0 with a
# rest frame only (a pose moves the torso and head by its offsets):
# testbird (avian, template biped-bird): torso, head, tail, two legs of its own (hind-testbird), a near and a far
#   wing on the torso's wing point, a crest (headFeature) on the head's feature point, its own eye; the seven poses.
# testurchin (radial, no head): torso, spines (back) on the torso's back point, its own eye on the torso's eye0; the
#   seven poses.
# testsnail (gastropod): foot (torso), head, shell (bodyFeature) on the torso's back point, its own eye; rest,
#   approach, recover, hit and faint: no windup and no strike.
# testplant (flora, template plant, no head, no eye): one torso; rest, disturb, harvest and grow.
# The avian and gastropod families have a fallback at the medium tier, the one tier they use.
palette
ramp testbird 1 2 3 4
ramp testbird-accent 5 6 7 8
ramp testbird-under 9 10 11 12
ramp testurchin 2 3 4 5
ramp testurchin-accent 6 7 8 9
ramp testurchin-under 10 11 12 13
ramp testsnail 3 4 5 6
ramp testsnail-accent 7 8 9 10
ramp testsnail-under 11 12 13 14
ramp testplant 4 5 6 7
ramp testplant-accent 8 9 10 11
ramp testplant-under 12 13 14 15

species testbird avian medium legs=2 eyes=1 iris=0 tail=1 template=biped-bird

species testsnail gastropod medium legs=0 eyes=1 iris=2 tail=0
species testplant flora medium legs=0 eyes=0 iris=0 tail=0 head=0 template=plant
